selected_controls.question: Two-end passage; lateral-wall/hull openings verified independently
Fixed-axis obstruction versus a separately certified bent passage; not a global critical-radius assertion
No strict free center anywhere in the finite hull, using a conservative nominal-grid perturbation bound

path_reference.discovery: Layered finite widest-witness search; success is verified by complete all-atom segment clearance, not its score or alleged global optimality.

threshold_extension.observable: Infinite designated axis clearance, not globally optimal passage capacity
threshold_extension.predicates: Strict positive-margin availability below; equality marginal; above certifies only that this fixed axis is blocked.

acceptance.positive_path: All selected atom-ball margins on every segment exceed 1e-6 A and the two unbounded axial tails are checked. The path includes the designated origin.
acceptance.physical_openings: Accept only complete independent convex-face/seam inventory, and identify free faces at the two ends. Do not infer this count from path endpoints or native links.
acceptance.negative: Accept finite-hull exclusion only if the original minimum radius plus probe exceeds the complete nominal-grid perturbation bound with positive margin.
acceptance.native: Record actual raw, typed and public results, supports, units, source IDs, physical unresolved reasons and graph-candidate path margins; never substitute expected classes for observations.

scope: Known development input. The original catalog has prior native observations; new reference/receiving is retrospective characterization, not a blind held-out benchmark. No original provider or remote coordinate submission.
